45e30a5d-86e6-465b-96b5-ce128e94e35f/Eve.en: Huanxin stepped into the stone formation. <NL>The runes on the five strange stones looked quite familiar, <NL>The red rune was like a blazing sun, the yellow like a golden lotus, the green like a young sprout, <NL>The blue rune surged like waves, the purple drifted like clouds, <NL>Reminiscent of the Five Elements Qi her Foster Father had once mentioned... <NL><NL>Before she could ponder further, a creaking sound was heard. A woodwing on Immortal Xu's arm flapped its wings and lunged straight at her!
45e30a5d-86e6-465b-96b5-ce128e94e35f/Eve.cn: 焕心步入石阵之中，<NL>只见五块怪石之上的符文颇是眼熟，<NL>其中红色符文形若烈日，黄色符文状似金莲，绿色符文犹如青苗，<NL>蓝色符文翻涌如浪，紫色符文缥缈似云，<NL>倒好似“义父”曾经提过的五行内力……<NL><NL>只是不及细思，忽闻咯噶一声，徐仙公臂上一只木鹞振翅而起，直扑而来！

9d372b67-491e-488d-ba4b-b028f9037b55/Eve.en: "Not seen you for a few days, little girl, and your skill has improved again. Remarkable, truly remarkable! <NL>Alas, before my Five Elements Stone Formation, you are utterly helpless..." <NL><NL>Immortal Xu tilted his head back, laughing with a creak. <NL>Huanxin, however, couldn't hear a word he said. Thinking back on the battle just now, she was deeply puzzled: <NL>How could Immortal Xu's wooden body be impervious to her blade? Why did her strike seem to disappear without any effect, as if landing land on cotton...
9d372b67-491e-488d-ba4b-b028f9037b55/Eve.cn: “几日不见，小女娃功力又有精进，了不得，了不得呀！<NL>可惜在我这五行石阵之下，却是毫无还手之力……”<NL><NL>徐仙公仰起头来，嘎吱大笑，<NL>焕心却全然听不进徐仙公所言，思及适才一战，心中好生疑惑：<NL>徐仙公这木人之躯，何以刀剑不侵？自己方才一击，怎么仿佛泥牛入海，竟无半分着落……

a94c755b-edb6-45ab-a7e2-7fecd5a865bb/Eve.en: "'Foster father' used the method of Heaven's Mechanism to recast all the body's joints for Immortal Xu,<NL>Immortal Xu, relying on Tianshu Morphling, mobilized the power of the Five Elements, operated secret Ingenuity, and actually made this the Wooden Dummy's body impervious to swords and blades!"
a94c755b-edb6-45ab-a7e2-7fecd5a865bb/Eve.cn: “‘义父’以天枢玄机之法，为徐仙公重铸周身关窍，<NL>徐仙公凭借天枢玄身，调动五行之力，运转秘法诀窍，竟使这木人之身刀剑不侵！”
a94c755b-edb6-45ab-a7e2-7fecd5a865bb/Eve.ru: ""Приемный отец" использовал метод Небесного механизма, чтобы переделать все суставы тела для Бессмертного Сюя.,<NL>Бессмертный Сюй, полагаясь на Морфлинг Тяньшу, мобилизовал силу Пяти Стихий, применил тайную изобретательность и фактически сделал тело этого Деревянного Манекена непроницаемым для мечей и клинков острия!"

a94c755b-edb6-45ab-a7e2-7fecd5a865bb/Opt.en: (What a wily old demon, truly full of tricks!)
a94c755b-edb6-45ab-a7e2-7fecd5a865bb/Opt.ru: (Какой хитрый старый демон, поистине полный уловок!)

904ae6cc-a415-47f8-a8a9-9fb15739be24/Eve.en: "But... the old monster, in order to operate the Heaven's Secret Apertures, converted his own Qi into <color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>Fire</color>,<NL>'Foster father' once said 'Yin and Yang, Five Elements, generating and overcoming', if we can make the old monster's Qi and Martial Arts conflict,<NL>In this way, although I cannot harm the old monster, he absolutely cannot bear the Recoil of his own Martial Arts..."
904ae6cc-a415-47f8-a8a9-9fb15739be24/Eve.cn: “不过……老妖怪为运转天枢秘窍，将自身内力转为<color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>纯阳</color>，<NL>‘义父’曾说‘阴阳五行，相生相克’，若能使老妖怪内力与功法冲克，<NL>如此一来，我虽伤不得老妖怪，他却绝难承受自身功法反噬……”

904ae6cc-a415-47f8-a8a9-9fb15739be24/Opt.en: (The 'Loong Claw Chain' the old demon just used was clearly of the <color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>Fire</color> attribute...)
904ae6cc-a415-47f8-a8a9-9fb15739be24/Opt.cn: （老妖怪适才所使「奇形龙爪索」，分明便是<color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>纯阳</color>路数……）
904ae6cc-a415-47f8-a8a9-9fb15739be24/Opt.ru: ("Цепочка из когтей Лун", которую только что использовал старый демон, явно была из <color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>Огонь</color> атрибут...)

d8193e98-c75a-4c90-9aa9-a47abaa14dd1/Eve.en: "You're too slow, little girl! <NL>Just kowtow to me and admit defeat!" <NL><NL>Immortal Xu snorted coldly, glaring at Huanxin, the woodwing on his arm flapping, ready to fly...
d8193e98-c75a-4c90-9aa9-a47abaa14dd1/Eve.cn: “小女娃太也磨蹭！<NL>还是快向老夫磕三个响头，就此认输了罢！”<NL><NL>徐仙公冷冷一哼，向焕心看来，臂上木鹞振翅欲飞……
d8193e98-c75a-4c90-9aa9-a47abaa14dd1/Eve.ru: - Ты слишком медлительна, малышка! <NL>Просто поклонись мне и признай поражение!" <NL><NL>Бессмертный Сюй холодно фыркнул, свирепо глядя на Хуаньсиня, деревянное крыло на его руке хлопало, готовое взлететь...

129030da-c9fa-4df2-8143-b347f61952ac/Eve.en: Immortal Xu, suffering from the recoil of his own martial arts, had his True Qi clash within him. <NL>Before Huanxin could make another move, he suddenly cried out, "Ouch!" and tumbled to the ground!
129030da-c9fa-4df2-8143-b347f61952ac/Eve.cn: 徐仙公遭自身功法反噬，体内真气相冲，<NL>不待焕心继续出手，忽然“哎哟”一声，摔倒在地！
129030da-c9fa-4df2-8143-b347f61952ac/Eve.ru: Бессмертный Сюй, страдающий от отдачи от своих собственных Боевых искусств, столкнулся со своей Истинной Ци внутри себя. <NL>Прежде чем Хуаньсинь успел сделать еще одно движение, он вдруг вскрикнул: "Ой!" - и рухнул на землю!

f4ce80c6-2d01-4f4b-951e-e4ab5126e31c/Eve.en: "Hehe, you know to borrow the power of the Wood stone formation. Quite perceptive! <NL>But '<color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>Excessive Fire</color> <color=#FiveElementType_Zixia>burns Wood</color>, <color=#brightblue>revealing its intensity</color>.' Even if my Elemental Qi is converted to <color=#FiveElementType_Zixia>Wood</color>, <NL>my 'Loong Claw Chain' can still be used without hindrance..."
f4ce80c6-2d01-4f4b-951e-e4ab5126e31c/Eve.cn: “嘿嘿，小女娃懂得借用紫霞石阵，倒有几分悟性！<NL>不过‘<color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>火多</color><color=#FiveElementType_Zixia>木焚</color>，<color=#brightblue>方显其烈</color>’，纵是内力五行转为<color=#FiveElementType_Zixia>紫霞</color>，<NL>老夫这「奇形龙爪索」用起来也无阻碍……”

ddd82045-249b-437b-ba5a-638c26941fb0/Eve.en: "Hehe, you know to borrow the power of the Water stone formation. Quite perceptive! <NL>But '<color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>Weak Fire</color> <color=#FiveElementType_Xuanyin>meets Water</color>, <color=#brightred>it will surely be extinguished</color>.' Even if my Elemental Qi is converted to <color=#FiveElementType_Xuanyin>Water</color>, <NL>the power of my 'Loong Claw Chain' cannot be fully utilized, but it's still more than enough to take care of you, little girl..."
ddd82045-249b-437b-ba5a-638c26941fb0/Eve.cn: “嘿嘿，小女娃懂得借用玄阴石阵，倒有几分悟性！<NL>不过‘<color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>火弱</color><color=#FiveElementType_Xuanyin>遇水</color>，<color=#brightred>必为熄灭</color>’，纵是内力五行转为<color=#FiveElementType_Xuanyin>玄阴</color>，<NL>老夫这「奇形龙爪索」不能完全发挥，对付你这小女娃却是绰绰有余……”

71b6dada-f968-4c64-89b5-36d82a1cdb36/Eve.en: "Hehe, you know to borrow the power of the Earth stone formation. Quite perceptive! <NL>But '<color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>Fire</color> scorches <color=#FiveElementType_Guiyuan>Earth</color>, <color=#brightblue>forging and strengthening</color>.' Even if my Elemental Qi is converted to <color=#FiveElementType_Guiyuan>Earth</color>, <NL>my 'Loong Claw Chain' can still be used without hindrance..."
71b6dada-f968-4c64-89b5-36d82a1cdb36/Eve.cn: “嘿嘿，小女娃懂得借用归元石阵，倒有几分悟性！<NL>不过‘<color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>火炙</color><color=#FiveElementType_Guiyuan>土结</color>，<color=#brightblue>炼质锻形</color>’，纵是内力五行转为<color=#FiveElementType_Guiyuan>归元</color>，<NL>老夫这「奇形龙爪索」用起来也无阻碍……”

70ab6ad0-291b-425e-ae28-682cfa2c4872/Eve.en: "Hmph! Little girl, you are too arrogant. <NL>I have spent a millennium on practice and cultivation. Do you think you can defeat me so easily?"
70ab6ad0-291b-425e-ae28-682cfa2c4872/Eve.cn: “哼！小女娃未免托大，<NL>老夫千载修为，岂是你能轻易取胜的？”
70ab6ad0-291b-425e-ae28-682cfa2c4872/Eve.ru: - Хм! Малышка, ты слишком самонадеянна. <NL>Я потратил тысячелетие на практику и самосовершенствование. Неужели ты думаешь, что сможешь так легко победить меня?"

81a37523-c249-46af-9fe6-c6544a616529/Eve.en: A strange rock stands here,<NL>on it runes resembling a golden lotus, below engraved with eight characters:<NL>«<color=#FiveElementType_Jingang>Purge Evils</color>, Tower Arrives, Breaking Filth».<NL><NL>"Hmm... 'Foster father' once said '<color=#FiveElementType_Jingang>Much Metal</color><color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>extinguishes Fire</color>, <color=#brightred>inevitable doom</color>',<NL>This <color=#FiveElementType_Jingang>Metal Qi</color> seems to conflict with <color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>Fire Martial Arts</color>?"
81a37523-c249-46af-9fe6-c6544a616529/Eve.cn: 一座怪石耸立于此，<NL>其上符文状似金莲，下方镌刻八字：<NL>「<color=#FiveElementType_Jingang>金刚伏魔</color>，楼至破秽」。<NL><NL>“唔……‘义父’曾说‘<color=#FiveElementType_Jingang>金多</color><color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>火熄</color>，<color=#brightred>必为灭亡</color>’，<NL>这<color=#FiveElementType_Jingang>金刚内力</color>，似乎正与<color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>纯阳功法</color>冲克？”

5939d708-b5fa-4faf-b66f-f715cefbe3c0/Eve.en: Huanxin focused her mind and channeled her Qi, activating the Strange Stone of Metal. <NL>A golden light suddenly flashed from the rune on the stone, and a beam of gold shot straight towards Immortal Xu... <NL><NL>(Immortal Xu's Elemental Qi attribute has been converted to <color=#FiveElementType_Jingang>Metal</color>...)
5939d708-b5fa-4faf-b66f-f715cefbe3c0/Eve.cn: 焕心凝神运气，催动金刚怪石，<NL>但见石上符文金芒乍现，一道金光直向徐仙公而去……<NL><NL>（徐仙公的内力属性被转变为了<color=#FiveElementType_Jingang>金刚</color>……）

c54d9c8f-2302-4394-9122-1beb559c6214/Eve.en: A strange rock stands here,<NL>on it runes surging like waves, below engraved with eight characters:<NL>«<color=#FiveElementType_Xuanyin>Chilling Yin</color>, Kun hides in the Northern Deep».<NL><NL>"Hmm... 'Foster father' once said '<color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>Weak Fire</color><color=#FiveElementType_Xuanyin>meets Water</color>, <color=#brightred>surely extinguished</color>',<NL>I wonder which is stronger, this <color=#FiveElementType_Xuanyin>Water Qi</color> or <color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>Fire Martial Arts</color>..."
c54d9c8f-2302-4394-9122-1beb559c6214/Eve.cn: 一座怪石耸立于此，<NL>其上符文翻涌如浪，下方镌刻八字：<NL>「<color=#FiveElementType_Xuanyin>玄阴冰寒</color>，鲲隐北溟」。<NL><NL>“唔……‘义父’曾说‘<color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>火弱</color><color=#FiveElementType_Xuanyin>遇水</color>，<color=#brightred>必为熄灭</color>’，<NL>也不知这<color=#FiveElementType_Xuanyin>玄阴内力</color>与<color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>纯阳功法</color>，究竟孰强孰弱……”

'Foster father' once said '<color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>Fire scorches</color><color=#FiveElementType_Guiyuan>Earth hardens</color>, <color=#brightblue>refined and forged</color>',<NL>This <color=#FiveElementType_Guiyuan>Earth Qi</color> does not seem to conflict with <color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>Fire</color>..."
0f4b2b4b-4efd-4ea0-b48c-8b208f2f09e4/Eve.cn: 一座怪石耸立于此，<NL>其上符文犹如青苗，下方镌刻八字：<NL>「<color=#FiveElementType_Guiyuan>归元化蕴</color>，承天载物」。<NL><NL>“唔……‘义父’曾说‘<color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>火炙</color><color=#FiveElementType_Guiyuan>土结</color>，<color=#brightblue>炼质锻形</color>’，<NL>这<color=#FiveElementType_Guiyuan>归元内力</color>，似乎并不与<color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>纯阳</color>冲克……”

bd1e3d53-f117-47c4-88d4-30455cf92769/Eve.cn: 焕心凝神运气，催动归元怪石，<NL>但见石上符文青光流转，一道青华直向徐仙公而去……<NL><NL>（徐仙公的内力属性被转变为了<color=#FiveElementType_Guiyuan>归元</color>……）

d7952765-7a98-48a5-b909-8069413b73dd/Eve.en: Huanxin focused her mind and channeled her Qi, activating the Strange Stone of Water. <NL>Frost condensed on the rune, and a blast of icy air shot straight towards Immortal Xu... <NL><NL>(Immortal Xu's Elemental Qi attribute has been converted to <color=#FiveElementType_Xuanyin>Water</color>...)
d7952765-7a98-48a5-b909-8069413b73dd/Eve.cn: 焕心凝神运气，催动玄阴怪石，<NL>但见石上符文冰霜凝结，一道寒气直向徐仙公而去……<NL><NL>（徐仙公的内力属性被转变为了<color=#FiveElementType_Xuanyin>玄阴</color>……）
d7952765-7a98-48a5-b909-8069413b73dd/Eve.ru: Хуаньсинь сосредоточила свой разум и направила свою Ци, активируя Странный Камень Воды. <NL>Иней сгустился на руне, и порыв ледяного воздуха устремился прямо к Бессмертному Сюю... <NL><NL>(Элементарный атрибут Ци Бессмертного Сюя был преобразован в <color=#FiveElementType_Xuanyin>Вода</color>...)

6c665af5-c665-4b73-93f3-8cc7c9c82103/Eve.en: Huanxin focused her mind and channeled her Qi, activating the Strange Stone of Wood. <NL>A purple mist swirled from the rune, and a beam of purple shot straight towards Immortal Xu... <NL><NL>(Immortal Xu's Elemental Qi attribute has been converted to <color=#FiveElementType_Zixia>Wood</color>...)
6c665af5-c665-4b73-93f3-8cc7c9c82103/Eve.cn: 焕心凝神运气，催动紫霞怪石，<NL>但见石上符文紫气氤氲，一道紫气直向徐仙公而去……<NL><NL>（徐仙公的内力属性被转变为了<color=#FiveElementType_Zixia>紫霞</color>……）
6c665af5-c665-4b73-93f3-8cc7c9c82103/Eve.ru: Хуаньсинь сосредоточила свой разум и направила свою Ци, активируя Странный Камень из дерева. <NL>От руны закружился пурпурный туман, и пурпурный луч устремился прямо к Бессмертному Сюю... <NL><NL>(Элементарный атрибут Ци Бессмертного Сюя был преобразован в <color=#FiveElementType_Zixia>Дерево</color>...)

655c310e-04eb-48ab-82cb-b7a3ac7ecd9d/Eve.en: A strange stone stands tall here. <NL>Its rune is shaped like a blazing sun, light swirling intensely, and nine words are engraved below: <NL>"<color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>Fire of Searing Yang</color> Is Like Pure Heart Undoubted". <NL><NL>"So the old demon uses this strange stone to convert his own Elemental Qi..."
655c310e-04eb-48ab-82cb-b7a3ac7ecd9d/Eve.cn: 一座怪石耸立于此，<NL>其上符文形若烈日，火光流转，灼灼逼人，下方镌刻八字：<NL>「<color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>纯阳炽火</color>，赤子不惑」。<NL><NL>“老妖怪便是用这怪石，转变自身内力……”

2ef72f74-7b41-42d6-8062-b51c8c6226b7/Eve.en: "If I could convert the old demon's Elemental Qi to make it clash with his <color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>Fire</color> Martial Arts, <NL>I would surely make him yield!" <NL><NL>Thinking of this, Huanxin was overjoyed and blurted it out. <NL>Immortal Xu, however, seemed not to hear, simply hugging his wooden arms and turning his face away, ignoring her.
2ef72f74-7b41-42d6-8062-b51c8c6226b7/Eve.cn: “我若能转变老妖怪内力，使之与<color=#FiveElementType_Chunyang>纯阳</color>功法冲克，<NL>定叫老妖怪乖乖认输！”<NL><NL>焕心想到此节，心头一喜，脱口而出，<NL>徐仙公却似充耳不闻，只抱起木臂，别过脸去，不再理会……

2ef72f74-7b41-42d6-8062-b51c8c6226b7/Opt.en: (But... how exactly do I change the old demon's Elemental Qi? That's the hard part...)
2ef72f74-7b41-42d6-8062-b51c8c6226b7/Opt.cn: （只是……我却要如何改变老妖怪内力，这可难了……）
2ef72f74-7b41-42d6-8062-b51c8c6226b7/Opt.ru: (Но... как именно мне изменить элементарную Ци старого демона? Это самая трудная часть...)

331ad77c-167f-4bc1-9a8e-eb8fab27c84c/Eve.en: Huanxin's gaze swept past Immortal Xu. <NL>Seeing the light swirling on the runes of the large red stone behind him, an idea struck her: <NL>"Could it be... the old demon uses this strange stone to convert his own Elemental Qi?"
331ad77c-167f-4bc1-9a8e-eb8fab27c84c/Eve.cn: 焕心目光掠过徐仙公身后，<NL>只见那方巨石之上，红色符文光芒流转，不由心头一动：<NL>“莫非老妖怪，便是靠这怪石转变自身内力……”
331ad77c-167f-4bc1-9a8e-eb8fab27c84c/Eve.ru: Взгляд Хуаньсинь скользнул мимо Бессмертного Сюя. <NL>Увидев, как свет кружится на рунах большого красного камня позади него, ее осенила идея: <NL>"Может быть... старый демон использует этот странный камень для преобразования своей собственной элементарной Ци?"

It was clear Immortal Xu had intentionally set up this formation to teach her the principles of Five Elements generation and overcoming. <NL>Although she knew he wasn't a good person, she couldn't help but feel a pang of guilt as she walked towards him...
